description: Presidential Secretariat - Order to acquire the Lands under Urban Development Projects Act
categorisation: This gazette content consists of multiple orders under the Urban Development Projects Act declaring that specific parcels of land are required for urban development projects. The content provides detailed descriptions of land parcels, including their locations, boundaries, lot numbers, and exact measurements. This falls squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisitions and property matters for development purposes, rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
